payload.title: CDN spike live half: shared distribution host routing and per-tenant purge on the shared staging stack (gated)
payload.description:
Gated task. D9 (Ryan, 2026-11-13, final): no sandbox account of any kind. The runtime half of the CDN spike (PPY-3b3cc3; offline part PPY-7cd7a2) can run, if at all, only on the shared STAGING stack's distribution, created by the release pipeline inside the existing Papyrus production account (PPY-daf673). No distribution, function or KeyValueStore is created by hand or by an ad hoc CLI call.

Runs only when both hold: (1) the shared staging stack exists, created by the pipeline (PPY-daf673); (2) Ryan has said go for this run.

Questions to answer at runtime, with evidence: the CloudFront Function maps a host to its tenant through the KeyValueStore and rewrites into the tenant prefix; an unknown host gets a 404; a purge for tenant alpha's page leaves beta's cached; whether an invalidation path matches the requested or the rewritten path; whether CloudFront's own multi-tenant distributions fit better (features, quotas, prices). Purges stay within the 25-path rule and go through the capped tooling, never a raw invalidation.

Until it runs, unproven: host routing and per-tenant purges on a real distribution. The choice between our host-routing function and CloudFront multi-tenant distributions stays provisional, and M4 shared serving (PPY-3bbbf9) must not ship to production before this has run.

Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR #1305), section What stays unproven until the staging stack exists.
